notes: The site lists businesses internationally by country, not by city/state. The 'Country' field is shown in the details table but no city or state/province is ever disclosed. Asking price is labeled 'Target Price:' consistently in the details table (table.details_table td.tablelabel). Revenue is labeled 'Gross Revenue:' and cash flow proxy is labeled 'EBITDA:' — the site does not publish SDE/owner benefit/discretionary earnings; EBITDA is the only profitability metric shown. The third page (organic-food-producer-and-exporter) returned a 404 error, so only two live listing pages were available for analysis, but the pattern is consistent between them.
